experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline

throughput.notes: Data-dependent. CPI ranges 6 to 17 over the same operand pairs; the stored experiment uses 1073741823/3.

notes: Latency model: the vector divider retires 4 quotient bits per cycle on every element width and the slowest lane dominates. lat = 11 when the quotient is 0, 17 when it fits in four bits, otherwise 17 + 2 * floor(bits(quotient)/4); for w elements the quotient is at most 32 bits, so the maximum is 33. The remainder path costs one extra cycle in the general case and keeps the same extremes pattern, reaching 33. Measured with a calibrated reset chain (closure 7 cycles) on the maximum-latency operand pair; 1000-unroll slope method.
